links.outcome: Reading level (SMOG) of ChatGPT-generated patient handouts versus grade 8 target
links.effect: Mean SMOG 10.9 years of education [95% CI 9.36, 12.4], exceeding the grade 8 upper limit for health-related patient handouts.
links.quote: Also, the mean SMOG score exceeded the accepted upper limits of grade 8 reading level for health-related patient handouts.
